about: Running costs as billed, each in the currency of its bill; amount null = bill not in yet, named in one 'Bills not in yet' row and left out of every sum. items: monthly; since = first month counted on the chart of /donate/ (YYYY-MM-DD, the bill repeats on that day each month; null = not on the chart). oneoff: single purchases with their date (YYYY-MM-DD), newest first. Time is never priced. Payments read from receipts by the server (node.tauhud.com/costs-paid.json, infra/alerts/receipts.py) are added on /donate/; the same payment in both is shown once. Read by /donate/, the About window and the Updates panel. n: short product name for that row.
